Source: [pkg/reasoning/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/pkg/reasoning/doc.go).

Package reasoning turns committed graph changes into signals and evidence-backed findings, in two independent stages: deterministic detection and agentic investigation.

The model is an advisory investigator. This package stays authoritative for which graph state is analyzed, what the model may see and retrieve, which references a response may cite, and whether a response becomes a finding.

## Pipeline {#hdr-Pipeline}

[Service.Run](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Service.Run) is detection. It consumes the contribution change outbox written by pkg/state, processes one window at a time, and never calls a model:

 1. [ReadChangeWindow](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#ReadChangeWindow) reads a contiguous batch of [state.ContributionChangeEvent](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#ContributionChangeEvent) values after the durable cursor, plus the coherent [state.GraphCheckpoint](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#GraphCheckpoint) that contains them. A sequence gap, or a batch that does not reach the checkpoint, is never filled by inference: the window is marked as a rebase to the checkpoint instead.
 2. A [detector.Detector](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#Detector) compares the previous and current snapshots and emits neutral [detector.InvestigationSignal](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/detector#InvestigationSignal) values. The window's signals are split by origin: active rule matches, shadow rule matches, and built-in novelty signals.
 3. [IncidentHistory](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#IncidentHistory) accumulates bounded telemetry baselines and an ordered timeline across windows; [IncidentContext](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#IncidentContext) is the pinned view of it.
 4. When a novelty signal is medium risk or higher, the window yields an [InvestigationRequest](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#InvestigationRequest): the change range, novelty signals, topology classification, and incident context scoped to the signals' anchors.
 5. The [ResultSink](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#ResultSink) values record the [Evaluation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Evaluation): [FindingSink](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#FindingSink) stores [RuleFindings](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#RuleFindings) and invalidates agentic findings grounded in a superseded graph digest, [SignalSink](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#SignalSink) records every signal, and [InvestigationQueue](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#InvestigationQueue) enqueues the request, coalescing it with queued requests that share an anchor. Only then does the cursor advance.

[InvestigationWorker](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#InvestigationWorker) is agentic investigation. It drains the queue independently, so a model failure retries a job instead of stopping detection:

 1. Claim the highest-risk job, drop anchors that left the graph, and apply the [SamplingPolicy](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#SamplingPolicy): deterministic rate sampling of medium risk, deduplication, and an hourly budget.
 2. Re-read the request's change range and build the canonical [Packet](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Packet) against the current checkpoint. Its AnalysisID is the SHA-256 of its canonical encoding, so identical inputs analyze identically.
 3. An [Analyzer](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Analyzer) (normally pkg/reasoning/modelanalyzer) runs [AnalyzeCandidateWithTools](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#AnalyzeCandidateWithTools). The model retrieves more context through the read-only MCP tools in pkg/reasoning/mcpserver, each answered by a [ContextProvider](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#ContextProvider) pinned to the packet's [AnalysisToken](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#AnalysisToken).
 4. [ValidateClassification](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#ValidateClassification) checks the response against the effective packet, with one tool-free repair turn. [Promote](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Promote) then applies the stricter promotion gate.
 5. [FindingSink.RecordInvestigation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#FindingSink.RecordInvestigation) persists a promoted finding with hydrated remediation proposals, and the worker invalidates it at once if changes committed during the model call touched its entities.

[Service.EvaluateWindow](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Service.EvaluateWindow) and [Service.EvaluateWindowWithIncident](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Service.EvaluateWindowWithIncident) run detection and then the same [Investigator](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Investigator) inline, for evaluation harnesses.

Remediation is not part of this pipeline. Reasoning may attach validated [remediation.Suggestion](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/remediation#Suggestion) values to a promoted finding, but it never selects a provider or plans, prepares, executes, or verifies an action; see pkg/remediation and pkg/api.

## What reaches the model {#hdr-What_reaches_the_model}

The initial packet contains no telemetry facts, provider-native configuration, candidate paths, or fixture labels. Packet and context construction additionally:

  - replaces evidence IDs with opaque "evidence:sha256:" handles;
  - drops resource and facet attributes whose key suggests credentials (password, token, authorization, cookie, API or access key, private key) and bounds attribute and name counts and lengths;
  - forwards only an allowlist of telemetry properties; and
  - omits telemetry assertion changes from the trigger window.

Eval campaign expectations live in the evals scorer and are never supplied to the model. Graph strings are untrusted data; [SystemPrompt](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#SystemPrompt) says so, and validation never relies on the model having obeyed it.

## Invariants {#hdr-Invariants}

  - Every retrieval is pinned to one analysis ID and graph digest; a query with another token is rejected.
  - A candidate that relied on truncated retrieval is rejected, because absence cannot be inferred from a partial view.
  - Finding identity is a digest of the promoted signal IDs and graph digest, so replaying an evaluation is idempotent.
  - The cursor advances only after the sinks record the evaluation.
  - Detection never calls a model; rule findings never depend on one.

See docs/architecture/change-feed-and-reasoning.md for the design and docs/operations/configuration.md for runtime flags.
